title: VeriIDE I/O Mapping Configuration
description: Schema for iomap/*.toml — channel mapping with scale/bias/safety limits

scale.description: Scaling factor (raw * scale + bias = engineering value)

direction.description: I/O direction (default: input for ai.toml, output for ao.toml)

st_type.description: SafeST data type written into the generated IOMAP entry; with direction it fixes the module kind (AI/AO/DI/DO)

point_name.description: Hardware point tag, unique within one station

unit.description: Engineering unit shown on pins and in the variable table

has_quality.description: Channel carries a quality bit. Section 3 of .sasm has no quality field, so this is station configuration consumed by simulation and monitoring only

fault_hold.description: Behaviour when the channel faults: keep last cycle value, fall back to a preset value, or leave it to the runtime default

preset_value.description: Fallback value used when fault_hold is 'preset'
